The Ray-Marching Algorithm - Scratchapixel
Figure 1: backward ray-marching. Marching along the ray in small regular steps forward, from t1 to t0. The algorithm works as follows: 1. Find the value for t0 and t1, the points where the camera/eye ray enters and leaves the volume object. 2. Divide the segment defined by t0-t1 into X number of smaller segments of identical size.
